milestone: Official BGE-M3 learned lexical retrieval mechanism comparison
dev: All 809 official SciFact train queries, full existing corpus and chunks
regression: All 300 official SciFact test queries; already exposed, not blind
mechanism: ReLU sparse linear over backbone token hidden states, repeated token max, exclude cls/eos/pad/unk and attention padding; query/doc sparse dot product without extra IDF
controls: Copy existing dense vectors and payload into separate isolated collection; same DB snapshot membership, query dense adapter, reranker, RRF, budgets and output; no production factory/schema/snapshot changes
runtime_policy: Share existing SentenceTransformer model weights; separate sparse forward per query is measured as actual extra work, not claimed free; no cross-request text or hidden-state cache
primary: Single nDCG@10 comparison; 10000 paired bootstrap over shared-positive-document connected groups, 95% percentile interval
secondary: Exploratory Recall@5/10/20, MRR@5/10, per-stage candidate coverage, sparse nnz, actual latency/cost
latency: Actual per-query randomized two-arm interleaving, shared warm models, concurrency 1, omit first query from both arms, no concurrent GPU/DB experiments
adoption: Passing DEV qualifies for further evaluation only; no change to production default or historical snapshot semantics
limits: Local retrieval benchmark, not platform Formal Experiment; no generated-answer/faithfulness claim or fabricated dollar cost

_publication.policy: case text, source corpus, requests, credentials and per-case objects omitted
